answer_1.quote: An explainer LLM is used to generate predicate-style descriptions for underperforming clusters of training examples.
answer_1.outputs: Natural language descriptions of systematic errors in text classifiers

answer_3.quote: we prompt the evaluator LLM to check if each example in the target cluster (and outside it) satisfies the predicate in the description.

answer_4.quote: we conduct a user study, in which users are shown examples or DISCERN descriptions of clusters where the classifier has a higher misclassification rate than its base rate.
answer_4.guideline: Users are tasked with identifying if new examples, drawn from one to two erroneous clusters per dataset, match the characteristics of given descriptions or cluster exemplars.
